title: trigger-api: implement the declared inbound-hook member through the same verifier, read `http.server` before the alias, and keep the self-hosted raw-app mount byte-unchanged (trigger-api segment 3 of ruling A on #22757)
body:
Blocked-by: #22772

Filing gate ③: a segment the maintainer's ruling directs. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) under ruling A on #22757 (director record `6105447950`, maintainer 「同意」), which directs triage to split the trigger-api member into the #22438 segment shapes (#22575–#22578). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope (the #22578 shape)

- `packages/triggers/trigger-api` implements the member #22772 declares, through the **same** `verifySignature` the raw mount uses: constant-time comparison, per-hook secret, verification before any run starts (ruling condition 2).
- **Carried from #22564's stage 1:** the producer resolves `http.server` first, then the alias (`plugin.ts` about `:77`).
- The raw mount stays byte-unchanged. ⛔ No double mount.
- **Not here:** replay protection, which is #22769 (condition 3, ⛔ not folded).

## Done when

- The member answers as the raw mount does: the same refusals, the same `202`.
- Pins:
  - the member is called on the hosted shape;
  - the raw mount is unchanged with `http.server`.

`domain:services` · p2 · `security`. It pairs with #22773; whichever lands second runs the end-to-end pin.
